name: Melody Music Bot
description: 🎶 Premium Telegram Music Bot — YouTube streaming, AutoPlay, Lyrics, Colored Controls

MONGO_DB_URI.description: NEW/live MongoDB Atlas URI for this Melody bot (mongodb+srv://...)

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram string session of assistant/userbot account

OWNER_NAME.description: Alias shown in play cards (e.g. Maestro) — NOT your real name

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Private Telegram group ID for error logs (e.g. -1001234567890). Must be a group where YOUR bot is an admin -- do not reuse an example/old ID.

GENIUS_API_TOKEN.description: Genius API token from genius.com/api-clients (for lyrics)

YT_COOKIES.description: Optional. Raw cookies.txt from a browser logged into youtube.com (use a throwaway account). Only used as a fallback retry — a free Cloudflare WARP proxy is the primary fix.

YT_COOKIES_2.description: Optional. cookies.txt of another YouTube account (#2). If one account gets flagged (152-18 / not a bot) the bot rests it and switches automatically. Up to YT_COOKIES_10 supported.

YT_COOKIES_3.description: Optional. cookies.txt of another YouTube account (#3). If one account gets flagged (152-18 / not a bot) the bot rests it and switches automatically. Up to YT_COOKIES_10 supported.

YT_COOKIES_4.description: Optional. cookies.txt of another YouTube account (#4). If one account gets flagged (152-18 / not a bot) the bot rests it and switches automatically. Up to YT_COOKIES_10 supported.

YT_COOKIES_5.description: Optional. cookies.txt of another YouTube account (#5). If one account gets flagged (152-18 / not a bot) the bot rests it and switches automatically. Up to YT_COOKIES_10 supported.

YT_COOKIE_COOLDOWN.description: Seconds a flagged cookie account rests before reuse.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: YouTube Data API v3 key — makes song search/metadata resolve in ~0.3s instead of several seconds. Comma-separate multiple keys to auto-rotate on quota.

MUSIC_ONLY_MODE.description: Load only music handlers to reduce startup/RAM (true/false)

PLAYBACK_RECOVERY.description: Rejoin old voice chats after restart; keep false for fastest safe startup

MONGO_GRIDFS_CACHE.description: Optional secondary GridFS upload cache; keep false on small Heroku dynos

SOURCE_CODE_URL.description: Optional public repository URL for the Source Code button. Leave empty to keep this build private.

MEM_SOFT_LIMIT_MB.description: RSS (MB) above which the memory watchdog trims freed memory back to the OS. Leave empty to auto-derive ~80% of the dyno quota.

USE_WARP.description: Route YouTube downloads through a free Cloudflare WARP proxy (fixes 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot' on Heroku). Default true on cloud hosts.

YT_PROXY.description: Optional: your own proxy URL (http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://...). Overrides WARP.

YT_COOKIES_MODE.description: fallback (default: cookies only on a retry), always, or off.
